 Clavicular slammed as his girlfriend shaves her head to stop him breaking out in acne
 Clavicular's girlfriend's shocking gesture toward him sparked much outrage online after he posted an alarming video of her abruptly changing her hairstyle for the influencer
 Add to preferred sources Entertainment Angelica Cheyenne 02:21 ET, 16 Nov 2026 Updated 02:27 ET, 16 Nov 2026 View 3 Images Clavicular sparked outrage online after he posted a video of girlfriend shaving her head (Image: clavicular/Kick) 
 Controversial content creator Clavicular, born Braden Peters, who gained internet fame for his obsession with "looksmaxxing," broadcast his on-and-off girlfriend Lily Snyder's disturbing gesture towards him.
 ‌ 
 On Sunday, November 15, the 20-year-old influencer shared a video on X, formerly known as Twitter , of Lily, 19, sitting in front of a mirror, buzzing all her hair off, while he appeared to be filming her. Clavicular captioned the X post, "Nocturnal facial contact with a woman's hair may expose skin to comedogenic hair-product residue, causing acne," seemingly implying that if his skin came in to contact with Lily's hair he'd get facial acne.
 He continued in the post, "My girlfriend in an attempt to aid me in my looksmaxing journey shaved all of her hair off. Very loving gesture, bare minimum lOI." It comes after Clavicular's ’ ex-girlfriend spoke about her experience with the image-obsessed streamer .
 READ MORE : Looksmaxxing influencer Connor Murphy drowned after appearing in new Hulu crime doc Get Huge READ MORE : Piers Morgan issues telling update on 20-year friendship with Donald Trump While Clavicular tried to flex how much Lily loved him online, it backfired, as many commented that it was shameful for him to encourage her to shave her head.
 "This is so f------ up can’t even defend this bro," one penned on X as another remarked, "Humiliation ritual lmao. Y'all have turned into straight jesters. How much do they pay you to humiliate yourselves like this?"
 Another shared, "This is straight up abuse, WHERE is this poor girls family? Friends? Anyone who can help her? I mean WTF" as someone else shared, "This is so sad. How could you do that to your girl you’re horrible."
 ‌ 
 View 3 Images Clavicular seemed to film her shaving her head
 Despite Clavicular's ragebait content often angering social media users, he continues to post outrageous videos, building his online reputation as a "looksmaxxer," meaning he does whatever he needs to continuously improve his physical appearance.
 ‌ 
 In September he broke his silence following charges being filed against him on September 8. The internet streamer faces one count of rape, one count of drugging a person for sexual intercourse, and one count of procuring liquor for someone under 21 years of age. The victim was not named in accordance with Massachusetts law.
 View 3 Images Some found Clavicular's move inappropriate 
 “Trying to get my attention in any way possible, a lawsuit? Seriously … really petty of you,” he wrote on social media in September, weeks after news of the allegations broke. In a separate X post at the time he also wrote, “Lmao was literally trying to work at Bacara as a bottle girl… how about don't finance cars you can't afford. Happens to all successful young men; people try to come for your money. Greed is evil."
 Last month, Clavicular pleaded not guilty to the charges as he continues to deny the allegations, claiming that encounter was consensual, according to ABC News.
